description: This file defines a React component for a network tab in a trace viewer, including data models, rendering logic, sorting, filtering, and interaction handling for network request entries.

classes.name: ContextIdMap
classes.description: Manages mapping of resource references to context IDs for display.

methods.name: useNetworkTabModel
methods.description: Creates a model for the network tab, filtering resources by selected time.

methods.name: NetworkTab
methods.description: Main React component rendering the network requests table and details view.

methods.name: columnTitle
methods.description: Returns the display title for each column.

methods.name: columnWidth
methods.description: Returns default width for each column.

methods.name: visibleColumns
methods.description: Determines which columns are visible based on selection and context count.

methods.name: allColumns
methods.description: Returns list of all possible columns.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders a cell for a given entry and column.

methods.name: ContextIdMap.contextId
methods.description: Generates a context ID for a resource based on its references.

methods.name: formatRouteStatus
methods.description: Determines the route status string for a resource.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts resources based on specified criteria.

methods.name: comparator
methods.description: Provides comparison functions for sorting by different columns.

methods.name: filterEntry
methods.description: Filters entries based on search value and resource type.
